meaning: Attract scroll message 'PRESS START' (the free-play start prompt). English literal EPRESS; rendered scrolling across the attract screen bottom by SCROLL (W3MAIN.MAC:5331).
The 'THE END' string, displayed in the game-over explosion (W3MAIN.MAC:4719 LDA I,MTHEEND ;DISPLAY "THE END" IN EXPLOSION) — i.e. during phase 'over'. English literal ETHEEND.
The 'GAME OVER' string (English literal EGAMOV). One of the coin-op scroll messages (MESDAT NOCRED list); shown at game end.
Attract title line 1 'MISSILE' (English literal EMISIL). With ECOMAN forms the 'MISSILE COMMAND' title on the attract screen.
Attract title line 2 'COMMAND' (English literal ECOMAN). With EMISIL forms the 'MISSILE COMMAND' title on the attract screen.
The 'HIGH SCORES' header (English literal EHISCR) labelling the high-score display slot on the attract screen — the container story mc7-4 fills with the ladder.

Attract-message scroll cadence: REFRESH gates SCROLL on LDA FRAME / LSR / IFCC (W3MAIN.MAC:5313-5319), firing SCROLL only when FRAME bit 0 is clear — one scroll step every 2 video frames. SCROLL_FRAMES_PER_STEP = 2.
